result.rationale: The new code in salesforce CalendarService checks `if (response.statusText !== "OK") throw new HttpError(...)`. statusText is unreliable — empty for HTTP/2 and may vary ("Ok", "ok") over HTTP/1.1 — so successful refreshes can throw a 400 with an empty message. This check is newly added by the diff, a real correctness defect.
